pretreatment: rinsed in a mixture of H2SO4:H2O2 (ratio 5:2) and heated on a hot plate at 80°C, washed with distilled water in an ultrasonic cleaner, cleaned with a 7% solution of HF and washed again with distilled water in an ultrasonic bath
evidence: Before the depositions, Si (100) substrate was rinsed in a mixture of H2SO4:H2O2 (ratio 5:2) and heated on a hot plate at 80°C. After that, Si (100) was washed with distilled water in an ultrasonic cleaner. In the next step, the samples were cleaned with a 7% solution of HF and washed again with distilled water in an ultrasonic bath.
